paper:2023-f602368a87.title: SyncDreamer Generating Multiview-consistent Images from a Single-view Image
paper:2023-f602368a87.tldr: SyncDreamer introduces a synchronized multiview diffusion model that correlates features across views with a 3D-aware attention mechanism to generate multiview-consistent images from a single view.
